resources.string: Large and old photos, videos and audio, and duplicates

To read the list of your photos, videos and audio, Android asks for access once. Activity+ only reads the file list and sizes. Nothing leaves your phone, and nothing is deleted without Android asking you first.
Without access nothing can be checked. You can allow it in the app settings.
You shared only some photos and videos with Activity+. This result covers only the ones you allowed.
No access to: %1$s. They are not included.
As far as Android lists them.
Files of 50 MB or more that have not been changed for a year.
Files of the same type and size are compared by reading the start and end of each one. A match is very likely, but not certain, the same file. This can take a while.
No two files share a size, so there are no duplicates.
Only the %1$d files that could free the most space were compared.
